about: A fast Markdown parser used by many websites and editors.

prs.title: Code blocks inside list items no longer turn into text
prs.broken: In a list item with a deeper indented line, a code block that followed was shown as plain paragraph text.
prs.changed: The parser now ends that line where it should, so the code block stays a code block.
prs.matters: Step-by-step docs with code in their steps show up correctly.
